Package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.metadata

package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.metadata
Annotations used to declare field variables as an element or type of a SysML metadata. SysMLinJava uses the annotations on fields to recognize and identify the elements that comprise the SysMLinJava model.
